scams.name: Bromo Jeep Tour Overcharge & Cemoro Lawang Kickback Ring
scams.description: Mount Bromo (2,329m) sits inside Bromo-Tengger-Semeru National Park and the iconic pre-dawn 4x4 jeep sunrise tour is the region's flagship experience — and hosts a 2025 overcharge ecosystem at every price tier. Community reports document the Cemoro Lawang village jeep-cartel pattern across the 2025 season. The legitimate cost: a full Bromo tour from Cemoro Lawang (King Kong Hill sunrise viewpoint + Sea of Sand crossing + Bromo crater approach) is Rp 700K–900K per jeep (4–6 people), 4 hours, with driver. From Malang, a 2-day-1-night package including transfer + homestay + jeep is Rp 1.2M–1.8M per person. The scams: (a) Jakarta/Bali agencies selling '3D2N Bromo tour Rp 5M+ per person' with 60%+ markup; (b) Cemoro Lawang village cartel refusing individual bookings, forcing tourists into Rp 1.5M+ 'group tour' even when the person only wants the jeep ride; (c) 'VIP jeep exclusive route' at Rp 2M claiming 'best viewpoint access' (all viewpoints are public); (d) 'sunrise guarantee fee Rp 500K' — weather can't be guaranteed; (e) Probolinggo-to-Cemoro Lawang 'direct shuttle' sold as Rp 500K per person when the real shared minibus is Rp 100K. Community reports also document the DIY option of arranging jeeps directly on arrival. For older travellers: (1) stay in Cemoro Lawang village overnight (Cafe Lava Hostel, Java Banana Lodge) — avoids pre-dawn transfer from Malang; (2) arrange the jeep DIRECTLY with Cemoro Lawang homestay at Rp 700K–900K per jeep (4–6 passengers); (3) alternative: join a pre-booked Bromo Jeep Tour via Klook at Rp 350K–500K per person group share; (4) REFUSE all 'VIP route', 'exclusive viewpoint', and 'sunrise guarantee' upsells; (5) for transfer from Malang/Probolinggo, use the Probolinggo-Cemoro Lawang shared minibus at Rp 50–75K per person (60 min) or pre-book Klook airport-shuttle; (6) King Kong Hill sunrise is the highest-payoff viewpoint — refuse to be diverted to 'Penanjakan 2' or 'Bukit Cinta' at higher cost; (7) altitude is 2,300m — arrive afternoon the previous day to acclimatise; (8) for older travellers with heart conditions, consult GP before altitude; Sea of Sand horse rides (Rp 125K) reduce walking if needed.
scams.avoidance: Stay in Cemoro Lawang overnight (Cafe Lava Hostel, Java Banana Lodge) Arrange jeep DIRECTLY with homestay: Rp 700K–900K per jeep (4–6 people) Alternative: Klook group tour Rp 350K–500K per person Use Probolinggo-Cemoro Lawang shared minibus at Rp 50–75K REFUSE all 'VIP route', 'exclusive viewpoint', 'sunrise guarantee' upsells
scams.location: Cemoro Lawang village (4x4 jeep staging), Tosari village, Malang/Probolinggo tour-agency booking offices, Juanda Airport (SUB) tour counters

scams.name: Bromo National Park Entry Fee Confusion & Fake-Ticket Fraud
scams.description: Bromo-Tengger-Semeru National Park charges a published foreigner day-rate that has CHANGED repeatedly in 2023–2025, and scammers exploit the confusion. The 2025 official rate: Rp 220,000 weekday / Rp 320,000 weekend-holiday for foreign visitors, paid at the park gate on entry, collected per-day. Community reports document the entry-fee controversy and tourist-vs-local pricing debate. The 2025 scams: (a) tour operators still quoting the old 'Rp 120K entry' and pocketing the difference; (b) homestay-bundled 'all-inclusive Rp 1.8M' packages that don't itemise the park fee, allowing the operator to claim Rp 500K 'gate fee' when it's actually Rp 220K; (c) 'fast-track ticket' resellers online selling 'skip-the-line Bromo entry Rp 500K' — no skip-the-line exists and the queue is 5–15 min; (d) fake-entry tickets printed and sold by roadside touts at Wonokitri and Ngadas approaches — these won't pass the gate check; (e) 'camera fee Rp 100K' demanded at jeep-staging (there is no separate camera fee). For older travellers: (1) the REAL 2025 fee is Rp 220K weekday / Rp 320K weekend-holiday per foreign visitor per day — paid at the park gate on arrival; keep the ticket receipt; (2) if your tour package claims 'entry fee included', ask for the Rp-value line-item BEFORE paying; (3) REFUSE any 'fast-track', 'skip-the-line', or 'camera fee' — none is legitimate; (4) buy tickets ONLY at the official park gate OR via the official BTS park e-ticket website (bromotenggersemeru.org); (5) NEVER buy from roadside touts at Wonokitri or Ngadas approach roads; (6) bring small-bill rupiah (50K, 100K, 200K) for exact change; (7) weekends and Indonesian public holidays (Eid, Christmas, New Year) see 3x the tourist density — weekday visits are cheaper and less crowded; (8) Javan public holiday calendar — check before booking to avoid peak-rate days.
scams.avoidance: Pay ONLY Rp 220K weekday / Rp 320K weekend-holiday at park gate Buy via bromotenggersemeru.org official e-ticket or at gate REFUSE all 'fast-track', 'skip-the-line', 'camera fee' claims Ask operator for Rp-value line-item on 'entry fee included' claim Weekday visits cheaper + less crowded than weekend/holiday
scams.location: Park entry gates at Cemoro Lawang, Wonokitri, Ngadas, and Tumpang approaches, jeep-staging ticket checks, homestay-bundled 'entry' pricing

scams.name: Bromo Horse Rental Forced-Tip & Crater-Approach Shakedown
scams.description: At the foot of Bromo crater, after the jeep drops tourists at the edge of the Sea of Sand (Pasir Berbisik), the remaining ~800m walk to the crater rim is partially done on horseback (optional for those with mobility issues). This horse-rental service is officially priced at Rp 125K round-trip — but the 2025 horse-handler cartel runs an entrenched forced-tip and upsell racket. Community reports document the horse-handler hustle as an ongoing source of tourist-experience friction. The 2025 scams: (a) handlers approach in the Sea of Sand before the tourist has committed, grab the jeep door, and quote 'Rp 250K one-way' (2x published rate); (b) after accepting, the handler pressures for 'tip Rp 100K per horse, Rp 200K for two' at crater arrival; (c) 'photo with handler at crater' commission (Rp 50K per photo demanded, not disclosed); (d) a few handlers claim 'return journey extra Rp 150K' — full round-trip is one fee; (e) horse welfare concerns — some horses visibly undernourished, carrying 80+ kg tourists up steep terrain. For older travellers: (1) the walk from jeep drop-off to crater rim is ~800m on volcanic sand + 253 steps up to the rim — strenuous but doable at 15-min-per-100m pace for fit 60+ travellers; if walking, skip the horse cartel entirely; (2) if using a horse, negotiate firm Rp 125K round-trip BEFORE mounting — reference the posted rate at Cemoro Lawang village; (3) refuse every 'tip per horse' demand at arrival — the Rp 125K is the full fare; (4) refuse 'photo with handler' commission — take your own photos; (5) bring small-bill rupiah to avoid 'no change' pressure; (6) for older travellers with knee or heart conditions, the 253 steps up to the rim are taxing — photograph from the crater base is sufficient if you can't climb; (7) consider horse welfare — choose a handler whose horse appears well-fed and hydrated; (8) Bromo handler association (if present) has uniformed staff — prefer these to random freelancers. Total crater approach: budget 45–75 min from jeep drop to rim depending on fitness.
scams.avoidance: If fit, WALK the 800m + 253 steps (15 min per 100m pace) — skip horses If using horse, negotiate firm Rp 125K round-trip BEFORE mounting Reference the posted rate at Cemoro Lawang village Refuse ALL 'tip per horse' and 'photo commission' demands Bring small-bill rupiah to avoid 'no change' pressure
scams.location: Sea of Sand (Pasir Berbisik) jeep drop-off, Bromo crater approach trail, Pura Luhur Poten temple base, horse-handler staging zone

scams.name: Bromo-Ijen Combo Tour Overpromise & Sleep-Deprivation Scam
scams.description: The combined '3D2N Bromo + Ijen from Bali' tour is one of East Java's most-popular packages and hosts a 2025 overpromise ecosystem that causes real safety concerns — specifically cumulative sleep deprivation. Community operator-recommendation threads document both the itinerary structure and the recurring complaints. The typical cram-everything package: Day 1: depart Bali 9 AM, 4-hour drive + ferry, arrive Probolinggo 3 PM, jeep to Cemoro Lawang, 4 AM jeep sunrise at Bromo, back to Cemoro Lawang 10 AM for breakfast, drive 5–6 hours to Banyuwangi, 12 AM depart for Ijen, 2 AM hike, sunrise blue flame, 6 AM back down, drive to Bali ferry. This compresses 2 volcano summits into 48 hours with <6 hours total sleep across two nights — genuinely dangerous for older travellers. The 2025 scams: (a) 'private 3D2N' sold at Rp 4M–6M per person when legitimate group tour is Rp 2M–2.8M; (b) unlicensed drivers on long transfers (Bali-Probolinggo-Cemoro Lawang-Banyuwangi-Bali is 800+ km across 3 days); (c) 'guide' on Ijen shakedown at the crater base (see separate scam); (d) 'include ferry' claim but tourists pay separately at boarding; (e) hostel 'homestay' that's a 6-bed dorm at budget tier when 'private room' was promised. For older travellers: (1) DO NOT do the 3D2N Bromo+Ijen cram from Bali if you're over 60 or have ANY heart/breathing condition; take 4D3N minimum with rest days; (2) book ONLY operators with Google/Tripadvisor 4.7+ and 100+ reviews; reputable 2025: Sun Bromo Tour, Flashpackers Bromo, Bromo Ijen Tour; (3) confirm in writing: specific hotels (not 'homestay'), private vehicle + licensed driver on EACH leg, meals, volcano entry fees included with Rp-value, gas-mask rental for Ijen; (4) reject 'private tour Rp 4M+' — legitimate private 4D3N is Rp 3.5M–4.5M; (5) for older travellers, consider Bromo-only (2D1N) OR Ijen-only from Banyuwangi (2D1N) — skip the double-summit exhaustion; (6) carry altitude sickness meds (Diamox) and discuss with GP before trip; (7) hydrate aggressively; cold mountain + altitude dehydrates fast; (8) insurance with trip-interruption + medical evacuation is essential.
scams.avoidance: DO NOT do 3D2N cram if 60+ or heart/breathing issues — take 4D3N+ Book operators with Tripadvisor 4.7+, 100+ reviews (Sun Bromo, Flashpackers) Confirm specific hotels, private vehicle, meals, fees, gas mask in writing Consider Bromo-only OR Ijen-only (2D1N) instead of double-summit Carry altitude meds (Diamox); buy insurance with medical evacuation
scams.location: Bali (Ubud/Kuta) tour agencies, Malang/Surabaya tour-operator booking offices, Klook/Viator online combo packages, Cemoro Lawang → Banyuwangi transfers

scams.name: Bromo King Kong Hill Viewpoint Fee Padding & Parking Tout Ring
scams.description: The pre-dawn sunrise viewpoint cluster on Bromo's northern ridge (King Kong Hill, Bukit Cinta, Penanjakan 1 & 2, Bukit Kedaluh, Seruni Point) is the tourist highlight of the Bromo experience and hosts a 2025 parking-tout and fee-padding ring. Community reports document the viewpoint pricing friction. The 2025 scams: (a) parking-tout 'attendants' at viewpoint approaches demanding Rp 30K–50K parking 'fee' — official parking is free and included in your park entry; (b) 'best viewpoint access Rp 150K per person' at King Kong Hill — all viewpoints are free after park entry; (c) 'premium photo spot Rp 100K' at Penanjakan 1 observation deck — no such fee exists; (d) hot-drink vendors at viewpoint quoting Rp 50K for instant coffee (Rp 10–15K legitimate); (e) jeep driver diverting from promised King Kong Hill to 'alternative better viewpoint' (actually farther from park, shorter tourist experience = faster driver turnover); (f) 'heat lamp rental Rp 75K' for pre-dawn wait (bring your own jacket). For older travellers: (1) confirm IN WRITING with jeep driver which viewpoint — King Kong Hill (Bukit Cinta) is the 2025 top pick for the 'iconic Bromo + Semeru' composition; Penanjakan 1 is the second choice; (2) REFUSE every 'parking fee' at viewpoint approaches — official parking is free after park entry; (3) REFUSE every 'premium access', 'best photo spot', 'heat lamp rental' upsell; (4) bring your own thermos with hot drink + snacks (0°C–5°C at 2,770m pre-dawn); (5) bring a warm jacket, beanie, gloves — many tourists underdress; (6) arrive 30–45 min before sunrise (check sunrise time daily: sunrise-sunset.org); (7) for older travellers with cold-weather sensitivity, a disposable HotHands hand-warmer is cheap and effective; (8) if jeep driver attempts to divert you to a lesser viewpoint, firmly say 'King Kong Hill saja' (King Kong Hill only) and refuse alternatives; (9) bring a headlamp or phone light — pre-dawn walk from parking to viewpoint is 100–200m in darkness.
scams.avoidance: Confirm 'King Kong Hill' in writing with jeep driver before departure REFUSE all 'parking fee' claims at viewpoint approaches (free after park entry) Refuse ALL 'premium access', 'photo spot', 'heat lamp' upsells Bring thermos, hot drink, warm jacket, beanie, gloves, headlamp Arrive 30–45 min before sunrise; say 'King Kong Hill saja' firmly
scams.location: King Kong Hill (Bukit Cinta) sunrise viewpoint, Penanjakan 1 & 2 viewpoints, Bukit Kedaluh, Seruni Point, pre-dawn parking approach roads

scams.name: Bromo Altitude Sickness & Fake 'Medical' Upsell Scam
scams.description: Mount Bromo's summit viewpoints sit at 2,300–2,770m — technically 'moderate altitude' — and while serious altitude sickness is uncommon, mild symptoms (headache, nausea, fatigue) affect ~10–15% of visitors on the rapid pre-dawn ascent from lower Java. This creates a 2025 medical-upsell scam targeting uncomfortable tourists. Community threads discuss altitude preparation and cover the altitude experience. The 2025 scams: (a) Cemoro Lawang homestay 'emergency oxygen Rp 300K per canister' sold when a tourist reports a headache — Indonesian pharmacy OTC paracetamol + water solves 95% of mild cases; (b) 'altitude sickness medicine Rp 250K' sold at jeep-staging (unbranded pills of unknown origin); (c) 'hot tea with secret herbs Rp 150K' claimed to cure altitude (Rp 15K ginger tea is the real traditional remedy); (d) 'private rescue vehicle Rp 1M' offered if tourist feels unwell — your jeep driver IS the rescue vehicle (already paid); (e) 'doctor consultation Rp 400K' at Cemoro Lawang from unqualified 'medic' — real medical care is 25 km away at Sukapura clinic or Probolinggo hospital. For older travellers — altitude sickness at Bromo's elevation is usually mild but should be taken seriously: (1) SLEEP in Cemoro Lawang the night before (2,217m) — acclimatises you for the 4 AM ascent to viewpoints (2,770m); arriving the same afternoon is the key preventive step; (2) hydrate aggressively — 2+ litres the day of arrival, 1 litre before sunrise trip; (3) avoid alcohol and heavy meals the evening before; (4) bring OTC paracetamol + ibuprofen + Diamox (prescription altitude medicine — consult your GP); (5) if you experience severe headache, confusion, or breathlessness — NOT mild symptoms — descend immediately (tell your jeep driver 'turun sekarang, sakit' = descend now, sick); (6) REFUSE every 'emergency oxygen', 'secret herb', 'doctor consultation' upsell at Cemoro Lawang — call your hotel or Probolinggo hospital (0335 422 033) for real medical need; (7) children and travellers 65+ with heart/lung conditions should CONSULT GP before Bromo trip; (8) ginger tea and paracetamol + rest resolve 95% of cases.
scams.avoidance: SLEEP in Cemoro Lawang night before — acclimatises for ascent Hydrate 2+ litres day before; avoid alcohol + heavy meals Bring OTC paracetamol, ibuprofen, Diamox (GP prescription) REFUSE all 'emergency oxygen', 'secret herb', 'private doctor' upsells Real medical need: Probolinggo hospital (0335 422 033)
scams.location: Cemoro Lawang homestays, Bromo jeep-staging area, Penanjakan 1 viewpoint, Bromo crater approach path, Sea of Sand rest stops
